For the 'Select' type, enter options separated by commas: 'Purchase, Support, Info' and the customer will see the numbered list.
The right-side preview simulates the WhatsApp screen in real time; use it to verify the order of questions before saving.

settingsProfile.title: What can I edit in my profile?
settingsProfile.description: Your profile stores your name, phone number, and job title within the platform. The email cannot be changed here because it is linked to your login account.
tips: Edit 'First name' and 'Last name' so your name appears correctly in the inbox and team reports.
The 'Phone' field is optional but useful if the team needs to reach you; use international format, e.g. +57 300 123 4567.
The 'Job title' field (e.g. 'Sales Manager') is only visible internally and helps identify your role within the team.
The email is locked (shows a lock icon) because it is tied to your authentication; contact an admin if you need to change it.

settingsPublicBooking.title: What is the public booking page?
settingsPublicBooking.description: It is a public URL where your customers can book appointments without needing an agent. You can enable it, customize the welcome message, and set your brand color.
tips: Enable the toggle to activate the page; a ready-to-copy link will appear so you can share it on social media or WhatsApp.
Use the 'Copy' button to get the exact URL and paste it in your Instagram bio or a WhatsApp broadcast message.
Click 'Show QR' to generate a downloadable QR code; great for printing on physical materials like business cards or flyers.
In 'Customization' you can write a welcome message (max. 300 characters) and pick the accent color of the page to match your brand.

settingsRecall.title: What is Customer Recall?
settingsRecall.description: Recall automatically sends a message to customers who have not interacted in N days, inviting them back. It works through the channel you choose (WhatsApp, SMS, etc.) and respects a cooldown period to avoid being intrusive.
tips: Enable the 'Recall enabled' toggle and set 'Days without interaction' (e.g. 180) to only contact truly inactive customers.
The 'Days between recalls' field (e.g. 90) prevents the system from messaging the same customer multiple times in a short period.
In the message, use {name} for the customer's name and {months} for months elapsed: 'Hi {name}, it has been {months} months since your last visit'.
Use the 'Run now' button for a manual test to see how many messages would be sent today; the system will show you the total sent.

settingsScoringConfig.title: How does lead scoring work?
settingsScoringConfig.description: Scoring assigns a score (0-100) to each lead based on 5 configurable weighted factors. You can also define purchase keywords and enable score decay for inactivity.
tips: Weights must add up to exactly 100%; if the total differs, the save button is disabled and you will see the percentage in red.
Increase the 'Intent' weight if your business relies on keywords like 'price' or 'buy'; decrease it if you prioritize stage history.
In 'Purchase keywords' add terms relevant to your industry (e.g. 'financing', 'installments') and press Enter or the '+ Add' button.
Enable 'Score decay' and set the days (e.g. 30) and factor (e.g. 50%) if you want inactive leads to lose points automatically.

settingsSecurity.title: How do I protect my account?
settingsSecurity.description: Here you can change your password, enable two-factor authentication (2FA) with an app like Google Authenticator, manage trusted devices, and configure SSO/SAML for your organization.
tips: To enable 2FA, click 'Enable two-factor authentication', scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, then enter the 6-digit code.
Save the backup codes somewhere safe outside the platform; if you lose access to your authenticator app, they are your only way to recover your account.
In 'Trusted devices' you can revoke access for a specific device by clicking 'Revoke'; use 'Revoke all' if you suspect unauthorized access.

If your organization uses SSO (Enterprise plan), enter the 'IdP Entity ID' and 'IdP SSO URL' from your provider (Okta, Azure AD, etc.) and enable 'Force SSO' to require all users to authenticate through it.

classes.title: How do I manage group classes?
classes.description: This section shows the class schedule for the next 30 days, grouped by day. From here you can create new classes and cancel existing ones, which automatically notifies enrolled members.
tips: Click 'Add class' to open the form: fill in the name, type (e.g. 'yoga'), instructor, date/time and max capacity before saving.
The progress bar on each card turns amber above 70% occupancy and red when full; use it to prioritise opening new spots.
Assign a 'Room' when creating the class so the instructor knows exactly where to teach; it appears on the card next to the location icon.
When cancelling a class the system asks for a reason; write it clearly (e.g. 'instructor sick') so it stays in the history and the agent can inform customers.

courses.title: How do I manage courses, cohorts and enrollments?
courses.description: This page organises the educational catalog in three tabs: 'Courses' (the base catalog), 'Cohorts' (scheduled instances with dates and instructor) and 'Enrollments' (students and their progress). It is the operations hub for the education vertical.
tips: Create the course first in the 'Courses' tab with name, modality (presencial/online/hybrid) and price; then use the 'Add cohort' button on its card to schedule a specific instance with a start date.
In the 'Cohorts' tab the 'Seats' column shows occupied/total with a colour mini-bar; if you see it in red (status 'full'), create an additional cohort so you don't lose interested students.
In 'Enrollments' check the 'Payment' column to identify students with 'pending' or 'partial' status; the agent can follow up on payment without you needing to export anything.
Add the 'Certification' field to the course (e.g. 'Digital Marketing Certificate') so the agent mentions it automatically when answering questions about course benefits.

foodOrders.title: How does the orders board work?
foodOrders.description: The board organises active orders into four columns by status: 'Received', 'Preparing', 'Ready' and 'Delivered'. It auto-refreshes every 15 seconds so the kitchen can follow the flow without reloading the page.
tips: Click the arrow button (→) on each card to advance the order to the next status, for example from 'Received' to 'Preparing'; this is the main action during service.
Cards with an amber border have been in their current status for more than 30 minutes; handle them first to avoid customer complaints about delays.
Click any card to see the full order detail: items, special instructions, delivery address and payment method; you can also cancel from there if needed.
Use the 'Refresh' button at the top when you want to force an immediate reload instead of waiting for the automatic 15-second interval, useful during peak traffic.

menu.title: How do I manage the restaurant menu?
menu.description: This page has two sections: categories in the left sidebar (e.g. 'Starters', 'Drinks') and catalog items on the right with price, tags and allergens. From here you can activate or pause items and update prices in real time.
tips: Use the green/red availability button on each item to mark it as 'Sold out' during service; the agent will automatically stop offering it until you reactivate it.
Click the '+' in the sidebar to create a new category (e.g. 'Daily special') and then assign dishes to it from the edit form of each item.
When adding or editing an item, select its tags (vegetariano, vegano, sin_gluten, picante, etc.) and allergens (gluten, lactosa, mariscos, etc.) so the agent filters correctly for customer queries.
The 'Prep time' field in minutes (e.g. 15) lets the agent give a realistic estimated wait time when a customer asks how long their order will take.

memberships.title: How do I manage gym plans and members?
memberships.description: This screen centralizes the membership plan catalog and the active member roster. You can create new plans, edit their benefits, and control each member's status without leaving the panel.
tips: Use 'Add plan' to create a new plan; fill in 'Class credits' and leave it empty for unlimited credits, e.g. a 'Premium unlimited' plan.
In the 'Members' tab, search by name in the search field and then click the snowflake icon to freeze a member's membership while they're on vacation.
Members expiring in less than 7 days appear with the date highlighted in yellow in the 'Expires' column; contact them before it lapses to retain them.
To unfreeze a member, find them in the table with 'frozen' status and click the 'Reactivate' button in their row.

insurance.title: How do I manage insurance policies and quotes?
insurance.description: This page organizes the full insurance lifecycle across four tabs: plan catalog, active quotes in pipeline, active policies, and ongoing claims. The AI agent uses these plans to auto-quote via WhatsApp.
tips: Create plans in the 'Plans' tab with type ('vida', 'auto', 'salud', etc.) and coverage level ('basico', 'medio', 'premium') so the bot offers the right option based on the client's profile.
In 'Quotes', review the 'Valid until' field to prioritize follow-up; expired quotes stay in 'expired' status and don't convert to a policy automatically.
In 'Policies', overdue payments appear in red in the 'Next payment' column; use that signal to trigger a WhatsApp reminder campaign from 'Broadcast'.
In 'Claims', the claim number (e.g. 'CLM-0042') is the official identifier; share it with the insured for tracking the indemnification process.

listings.title: How do I publish and manage sale or rental listings?
listings.description: This page displays the property catalog loaded into the platform, supporting both sale and rental types. Each listing is the source of information the AI agent consults to respond to prospects via WhatsApp.
tips: Use the 'Sale', 'Rental', or 'All' filter pills at the top to segment your inventory and quickly find the property you need to update.
When creating a listing with 'Create listing', first choose the transaction type (sale in purple, rental in green) — this field determines how the bot presents the price to the client.
Fill in 'Neighborhood' and 'City' in the creation form; the agent uses that data to answer questions like 'do you have anything in Chapinero under 2 million?'.
Click any card in the catalog to open the property detail page where you can add photos, extended description, and additional features.

pets.title: How do I view and manage my clients' pets?
pets.description: This screen shows the centralized list of pets registered at the clinic, linked to their owners in the CRM. From here you can filter by species, search by name, and access each patient's full history.
tips: Use the 'Dogs', 'Cats', or 'Others' tabs to filter by species; when a client writes on WhatsApp asking about their pet, you can locate their record in seconds.
Type the pet's or owner's name in the search field (magnifying glass, top right) to quickly find 'Max' or 'Luna' among hundreds of records.
The vaccination count and 'Last visit' date on each card show which pets have an outdated vaccination schedule — prioritize those for preventive campaigns.
Click any card to go to the owner's profile in the CRM, where you can view the full history, add notes, and schedule the next appointment from the Appointments module.

photoSessions.title: How do you manage your photo sessions?
photoSessions.description: This section displays all your clients' photo sessions with their status, hired package, and deliverables. Use it to track progress from the scheduled session all the way to gallery delivery.
tips: Use the 'Scheduled', 'In progress', and 'Delivered' tabs to focus on sessions that need attention right now.
The image counter (e.g. '12 / 30') shows how many photos you have already delivered out of the total agreed with the client.
If a session already has a ready gallery, the 'View gallery' link appears — share it directly from here with your client.
Use the search bar at the top to quickly find a client by name or phone without switching tabs.

tours.title: How do you manage your tours and packages?
tours.description: Here you can create and manage the tour packages you offer: same-day tours (hours) or multi-day tours, with price, maximum capacity, and available languages. The AI agent will use this information to quote and book with travelers.
tips: When creating a package, choose 'Same day' if the tour lasts hours, or 'Multi-day' if it includes overnight stays — this affects how the agent presents the offer.
Fill in the 'Destination' field with the place name (e.g. 'Cartagena, Colombia') so it appears with the location icon on the card.
Enable the languages you offer under 'Available languages' so the agent handles bookings in that language automatically.
Click a package card to edit it and add images — packages with photos have a higher conversion rate in agent conversations.

treatmentPlans.title: How do you track treatment plans?
treatmentPlans.description: This table displays all treatment plans assigned to your patients, with their session progress, current status, and total cost. It helps your health team monitor each patient's progress without missing any session.
tips: Use the 'Active' tab by default to see only ongoing plans — paused or completed plans appear in their respective tabs.
The progress bar (e.g. '4 / 10') shows completed sessions out of the total; click the patient's name to go to the contact detail.
Search by patient name or phone number in the search field to quickly find a specific plan among all active ones.
The status icon (green = active, orange = paused, blue = completed) gives you the plan's health overview at a glance in the 'Status' column.

serviceRequests.title: How do you operate the service requests board?
serviceRequests.description: This board is the dispatch center for home services: it shows each request with its urgency, service type, address, and assigned technician. It auto-refreshes every 20 seconds so the operations team can act in real time.
tips: Use the 'Emergency' filter to see only urgent requests and prioritize them before 9 AM with the 'Advance' button.
Click any request in the list to open the detail panel, where you can assign the technician, schedule the date, and record the estimated cost.
Emergency requests that have been waiting more than 30 minutes without attention are highlighted in red — handle them first to avoid cancellations.
The 'Advance' button moves the request to the next state in the flow (pending → quoted → scheduled → dispatched → in progress → completed) without opening the modal.

channelsEmail.title: How do I connect the email channel?
channelsEmail.description: The email channel lets you send outbound messages from Parallly using your own SMTP server or the SendGrid API. To connect it you need an active provider account (Gmail/Workspace, Outlook, SendGrid or another SMTP) and access to the authentication credentials.
tips: Choose your provider: click 'SMTP' or 'SendGrid' in the 'Provider' section, then expand the settings using the arrow. For Gmail use host 'smtp.gmail.com', port 587 and TLS encryption; enable 'App Passwords' in your Google account if you have 2FA active.

Fill in the sender fields: enter the email address messages will be sent from in 'From Email' (required) and the visible name in 'From Name'. Optionally add a 'Reply-To' address if you want replies to go to a different inbox.
If you use SendGrid as provider, paste your API Key (starts with 'SG.') in the corresponding field. Make sure the key has the 'Mail Send' permission enabled in your SendGrid dashboard.

Troubleshooting: if the status stays 'Not configured' after saving, check that 'From Email' is a valid address and that your SMTP credentials are correct. For Gmail the password must be a 16-character 'App Password', not your regular account password.

channelsInstagram.title: How do I connect Instagram DM?
channelsInstagram.description: The Instagram DM channel lets your AI agent respond to direct messages on Instagram from Parallly via Meta's official OAuth. To connect it you need a 'Professional' Instagram account (Business or Creator) linked to a Facebook Page.
tips: Key prerequisite: your Instagram account must be a 'Business' or 'Creator' type and linked to a Facebook Page. If you have a personal account, convert it to a professional one in Instagram's settings before continuing.

Click 'Connect with Instagram': a Meta popup will open. Log in with the Instagram account you want to connect, accept the 'instagram_business_basic' and 'instagram_business_manage_messages' permissions and complete the flow.

After authorizing, the panel shows the account name, profile picture, and token expiration date (long-lived tokens last ~60 days). The system renews the token automatically, but if you see the 'Expired token' alert, click 'Reconnect'.

Troubleshooting: if the popup doesn't open, disable the browser's popup blocker for this site. If the button stays on 'Connecting...' indefinitely, refresh the page and try again; the flow uses BroadcastChannel to communicate the result between windows.

channelsMessenger.title: How do I connect Messenger?
channelsMessenger.description: The Messenger channel connects your AI agent to your Facebook business page's Messenger conversations using the official Facebook login (FB SDK). To connect it you need to be an administrator of the Facebook Page you want to link.
tips: Prerequisite: you must be an administrator of the Facebook Page you want to connect. The page must have 'Messages' enabled in its settings (Settings → General → Messages). If the page doesn't appear in the selector, check your role.

Click 'Connect with Facebook': the Facebook login dialog will open. Sign in with your Facebook account, select the business page and grant the 'pages_messaging', 'pages_show_list' and 'pages_manage_metadata' permissions.

After authorizing, the panel lists the connected pages with their photo, name and ID. You can connect multiple pages in the same tenant if your plan allows it. Each page is associated with an AI agent.

Troubleshooting: if the 'Connect with Facebook' button is disabled when you arrive, wait 1-2 seconds for the Facebook SDK to load. If the error says 'configIdNotSet', the platform administrator needs to set the 'NEXT_PUBLIC_MESSENGER_FB_LOGIN_CONFIG_ID' environment variable on the server.

channelsSms.title: How do I connect the SMS channel?
channelsSms.description: The SMS channel sends and receives text messages via Twilio. To connect it you need an active Twilio account with a purchased phone number and the authentication credentials from your Twilio project.
tips: Get your credentials: go to console.twilio.com and copy the 'Account SID' and 'Auth Token' shown at the top of the dashboard. These are the two values you need to enter in Parallly to authenticate the connection.

Buy or use a Twilio number: in the Twilio console go to 'Phone Numbers → Manage → Active Numbers'. If you don't have one, buy a number with SMS capability. Copy the number in E.164 format (e.g. +15551234567) to enter it in Parallly.

Set up the Twilio webhook: in the Twilio console, select your number and in the 'Messaging' section paste Parallly's webhook URL in the 'A message comes in' field. Make sure to select the POST method.

Troubleshooting: if messages aren't arriving, check that the webhook is saved in Twilio and that the number has SMS capability enabled. Twilio trial numbers can only send to verified numbers; switch to a production number to receive from any contact.

channelsTelegram.title: How do I connect Telegram to Parallly?
channelsTelegram.description: Telegram connects through a bot you create yourself in minutes. You need an active Telegram account and access to @BotFather to get the token.
tips: Open Telegram and search '@BotFather'. Send /newbot, choose a display name and a username ending in 'bot' (e.g. MyStoreBot). BotFather will give you a token in the format '123456789:AAH...'.
Copy the full token and paste it in the 'Bot Token' field in step 2. The token is sensitive: never share it or include it in public code.
Click 'Connect' and wait for validation. If you see your bot name confirmed, the webhook was registered automatically.
If the token is rejected, make sure you copied it in full (including the colon ':' and all characters). If you revoked it in BotFather, generate a new one with /revoke and try again.

channelsWhatsapp.title: How do I connect WhatsApp Business to Parallly?
channelsWhatsapp.description: The connection uses Meta's Embedded Signup: an official flow that links your WhatsApp Business number directly from the dashboard. You need a Meta Business account and a phone number not already linked to the personal WhatsApp app.
tips: Before starting, create or verify your account at 'business.facebook.com'. The number you use must be free from personal WhatsApp (if it's on your phone, remove it from the app first).

Choose the right route: 'New number' to start fresh, 'Coexistence' if you already use that number in the WhatsApp Business app and want the AI to share it, or 'Migration' to move the number to the API (you'll stop receiving messages in the app).
Click the green connect button and complete Meta's flow in the popup window. Grant the requested permissions and select the Facebook page linked to your business.

If you see the error 'number already registered', make sure it is not active in another Meta Business account. For the Migration route, disable two-step verification in the WhatsApp Business app before starting.

channelsWhatsappProfile.title: How do I edit the WhatsApp Business public profile?
channelsWhatsappProfile.description: From here you manage the information customers see when they open your chat on WhatsApp: photo, description, address, website, and industry. Changes sync directly with the Meta API.
tips: To upload a profile photo, click the camera icon. Only JPG or PNG files up to 5 MB are accepted. The image is cropped to a circle, so use centered square images.
Fill in the 'Description' field with up to 512 characters: explain what your business does, your hours, and value proposition. This text appears on the profile before customers message you.
Choose the 'Vertical' (industry) that best describes your business: this helps Meta categorize your account. Click 'Save changes' after editing any field.

If the name status shows 'DECLINED', the verified name was rejected by Meta. Make sure it matches your business legal name exactly. A red 'Quality' indicator means you should reduce unwanted or spam messages to avoid restrictions.

channelsWhatsappTemplates.title: How do I create and manage WhatsApp templates?
channelsWhatsappTemplates.description: Templates are Meta pre-approved messages you can send when the 24-hour conversation window is closed. You need WhatsApp Business connected to create or sync templates.
tips: To create a template, click '+ New template'. Set the name (lowercase only, no spaces), language, category (UTILITY for transactional, MARKETING for promotions, AUTHENTICATION for codes), and message body. Use {{1}}, {{2}} for dynamic variables.
Click 'Sync from Meta' to import templates already approved in your Meta Business Manager account. This updates the status (APPROVED / PENDING / REJECTED) of each template.
A PENDING template can take from minutes to 24 hours to be reviewed by Meta. APPROVED templates appear in green and can already be used in broadcast campaigns or the AI agent.
If a template is REJECTED, check the rejection reason shown on the card (e.g. 'Promotional content in UTILITY category'). Adjust the content to match the correct category and create a new version.

calendarSync.question: How do I enable calendar synchronization?
calendarSync.answer: Go to the Appointments section -> Calendar Settings and click 'Connect Google Calendar' or 'Connect Microsoft Outlook'. The system will validate your busy slots and avoid collisions automatically.

businessHours.question: Where do I configure business hours?
businessHours.answer: Under Settings -> Business Hours you can set your business time zone and the active weekly window. The AI agent will respect these hours and apply out-of-office flows when needed.

leadScore.question: What is the Lead Score and how do I customize it?
